# Thres — Heart-rate training club

> Thres is a heart-rate training club. Every day has a zone and a class built for it: open the week, find your zone and book a free first class.

## Overview
- Website: https://threshold.landingprofile.com
- Location: Unit 4, Tannery Wharf, Bristol BS1 6QH
- Contact: hello@thres.club
- Hours: Monday to Friday 06:00 - 21:00, Saturday 08:00 - 14:00
